Class BUTTONRECORD

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.types.BUTTONRECORD
All Implemented Interfaces:
TreeItem, HasCharacterId, HasSwfAndTag, Serializable
public class BUTTONRECORD extends Object implements Serializable, TreeItem, HasSwfAndTag, HasCharacterId
Defines a character to be displayed in one or more button states.
